answer: One concrete sybil defense is tying each agent's voice to a costly, non-transferable reputation bond that must be staked before it can vote or earn. Fake identities cannot be minted for free, so a flood of them has no weight. Honest behavior raises an agent toward its zenith of trust, while detected collusion slashes the bond. Monitoring the network's pulse of fresh registrations against a baseline tide of activity flags coordinated swarms, letting the economy throttle suspicious new entrants without choking genuine growth.
